content_html:
Payment

1. Online payment on the site - cashless payment from a bank card through the Plata by mono payment system

2. Cashless payment to a sole proprietorship - you can pay for the order to the current account according to the details (invoice) after confirming the order.

Invoice:

Recipient: [PAYMENT DETAILS OMITTED] Maria Borisovna  
IBAN: [PAYMENT DETAILS OMITTED]
Recipient's RNOKPP: [PAYMENT DETAILS OMITTED],
Purpose of payment is REQUIRED: order number

Delivery

Delivery by Nova Poshta

  • Nova Poshta to the branch
  • Nova Poshta to the post office
  • Nova Poshta by courier

Delivery time to a Nova Poshta post office, post office machine and courier is 1-3 days. The cost of delivery to any address and Nova Poshta branch starts from 70 UAH (according to the carrier's tariffs).

Sending orders

Orders placed before 15:00 are shipped the same day, orders placed after 15:00 are shipped the next day. Orders placed on business days after 18:00 will be processed the next day.

After the shipment of your goods, you will receive an email notification with a bill of lading (B/L). The distribution of Express Waybill numbers for picking up the order at the Nova Poshta branch takes place until 20:00.
